high_level_description: This image features a tall, slender structure that appears to be a minaret or part of a mosque, covered with a black cloth adorned with gold patterns and Arabic calligraphy. The structure is made of stone and has a geometric design with pointed arches and angular lines. The black cloth draped over the structure has intricate gold designs, including floral motifs and what seem to be religious symbols. The Arabic calligraphy on the cloth reads "عيد مبارك," which translates to "Eid Mubarak" in English, a traditional greeting for the celebration of Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha.
